chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Artie Shaw brings Tony Pastor to hear McRae
summary: Shaw sent Pastor to learn from McRae's playing, and the band greeted him at a Boston reunion.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

He actually brought whatchacallem -- Tony Pastor over to the club. And they was dancing around
